# Group 4 — Volume Index

**Every title from both Group 4 sources, preserved and routed.**

Two sources exist and they do not enumerate the same things:

| Source | Shape | Items |
|---|---|---:|
| `GROUP4_master_ai_operating_system.txt` (**v1**) | Table of contents only | 186 numbered chapters |
| `GROUP4_master_ai_operating_system_v2_complete.txt` (**v2**) | Complete document, a statement under every section | 118 named sections |

**v2 is not a superset of v1.** It carries substance v1 never had — a statement
under every section, a Decision Governance section, an AI Hub and Experience
block, an explicit trading-domain preservation clause — while naming far fewer
items than v1's 186 chapters. Adopting either alone would drop titles the other
names, which the source's own opening rule forbids: **ADD AND EXPAND; NEVER
SILENTLY REMOVE.** So both are listed here, side by side, per volume.

**Generated from both sources**, not retyped, and checked two ways:

- `python scripts/group4_preservation.py` fails if any title from either source
  stops being listed here.
- `python scripts/group4_index.py --check` fails if this file has drifted from
  what the sources produce.

A preservation rule enforced by intention is not enforced.

Routing points at the group that owns each area rather than restating it — the
same relationship rule Groups 1–3 follow. It is decided in `scripts/group4_index.py`,
so a routing change is a reviewable diff.

| Implementation Backlog Preservation | All capabilities in this volume remain mandatory architecture/backlog scope. Implementation may be phased, but no item is deleted merely because it is not built yet. |

## Preservation

Both sources are preserved verbatim in `docs/ai/specs/`. Volume I is promoted
to `GROUP4_CONSTITUTION.md` at T0. Volume VIII is specified in full as Group 2
Part VIII, Chapters 28–34. Everything else routes to the group that owns it.

Nothing is removed. All 304 titles across the two sources are listed here or in
the constitution, and `scripts/group4_preservation.py` is what makes that a
statement rather than a promise.
